claim: The graph-as-work-index holds at authoring time and is untested at working time: no mechanism yet queries the graph contextually at decision time, and whether working sessions reach for the unlinked backlog rather than plan files is behavioral. The stasis-then-test phase is the experiment that decides it.

evidence.detail: Extracted from the obligation-lives-in-the-graph position; the same authored-versus-working-time gap the README's honest-status names for context loading, applied to work tracking. Falsified one way or the other by the testing phase.
